report_name: Suno AI Music Platform Breach Exposes 55.3 Million User Records

identities.name: Suno
identities.description: An AI-powered music generation platform that suffered a major data breach exposing the records of 55.3 million users.

indicators.name: Potential API User Data Scraping
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential API User Data Scraping
id: 2b1a9c8d-4e5f-4a3b-8c7d-9e8f7a6b5c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects access to API endpoints potentially used for user data scraping, as mentioned as a possible vector in the Suno data breach report. High volume from a single source may indicate malicious activity.
references:
  - https://www.crowe.com/ae/news/critical-cves-and-data-breaches
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1119
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/api/users/export'
      - '/api/v1/users'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects access to API endpoints that could be used for bulk user data enumeration or scraping, based on hunting hints provided in the Suno breach analysis.

indicators.name: Web Application SQL Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Web Application SQL Injection Attempt
id: f9e8d7c6-b5a4-4987-6543-210987654321
status: experimental
description: Detects a potential SQL Injection attempt using 'union select' patterns, a technique speculated as a possible vector in the Suno data breach.
references:
  - https://www.crowe.com/ae/news/critical-cves-and-data-breaches
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-query|contains: 'union select'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests containing 'union select' patterns, indicative of a SQL injection attempt, a method speculated to have been used in the Suno data breach.
